issues.problem: The pwn-request rule only matches literal, case-sensitive head expressions in checkout ref/repository. GitHub expressions are case-insensitive. Missed: upper-case GITHUB.EVENT.PULL_REQUEST.HEAD.SHA; index syntax github.event['pull_request']['head']['sha']; a ref taken through env (top-level env R=head.sha, then ref: ${{ env.R }}) or through needs.*.outputs; workflow_run.pull_requests[0].head.sha; and the common 'gh pr checkout "$N"' or 'git fetch origin pull/$N/head' run steps with N set through env. No repo workflow uses privileged triggers, so there is no current exposure.
issues.evidence: REVF-H3b-r5-probe/wf5.py and wf5b.py: prt_UPPER_expr, prt_index_syntax, prt_via_env, prt_via_job_output, prt_gh_pr_checkout_env, prt_git_fetch_env and wr_pull_requests_idx are MISSED.
issues.suggested_fix: Fail closed: reject any pull_request_target or workflow_run workflow unless it is explicitly allowlisted, or at least make HEAD_REF re.I, also match pull_requests[ and the ['head'] index syntax, and flag gh pr checkout / pull/*/head in run steps of privileged workflows.
